actors.title: ATS Jobs Scraper (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby +6)
actors.description: Scrape open jobs from company careers pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor and Rippling. Pass careers URLs or plain company names; the ATS is auto-detected. Returns title, location, remote flag, department, parsed salary, posted date and description. Priced per job returned.

params.name: companies
params.description: Careers page URLs (e.g. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/linear) or company names (e.g. 'Discord').

params.name: titleKeywords
params.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these words.

params.name: locationKeywords
params.description: Keep jobs whose location contains any of these words.

params.name: remoteOnly
params.description: Only remote jobs.

params.name: postedWithinDays
params.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (0 = any).

params.name: includeDescription
params.description: Include the plain-text job description (default true).

params.name: maxJobsPerCompany
params.description: Cap per company (default 30).

actors.title: Workday Jobs Scraper
actors.description: Scrape every job from any Workday career site (myworkdayjobs.com), including past Workday's 2,000-result cap. Pass Workday site URLs or company names. Returns title, location, posted date, parsed salary and full description. Priced per job returned.

params.name: siteUrls
params.description: Workday career site URLs, e.g. https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite

params.name: companies
params.description: Company names to look up on Workday (use instead of or with siteUrls).

params.name: searchText
params.description: Workday search text, e.g. 'software engineer'.

params.name: locationKeywords
params.description: Keep jobs whose location contains any of these words.

params.name: remoteOnly
params.description: Only remote jobs.

params.name: postedWithinDays
params.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (0 = any).

params.name: includeDetails
params.description: Fetch full description and salary (default true).

actors.title: Bulk PageSpeed & Core Web Vitals Checker
actors.description: Run Google PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse on many pages or whole sites. Returns performance, SEO, accessibility and best-practices scores, real-user Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) with pass/fail, and the top fixes per page. Priced per audit.

params.name: urls
params.description: Exact page URLs to audit.

params.name: startDomains
params.description: Whole websites to audit; pages are discovered from the sitemap.

params.name: maxPagesPerSite
params.description: Pages per site when using startDomains (default 25).

params.name: strategy
params.description: Device to emulate (default mobile).

params.name: fieldDataOnly
params.description: Only real-user Core Web Vitals, no Lighthouse run (fast and cheap).

actors.title: UK New Company Leads (Companies House)
actors.description: Find newly incorporated UK companies from the official Companies House register, filtered by date, SIC code or industry keyword, location and company type. Returns company number, name, address, SIC descriptions and directors. Priced per company.

params.name: daysBack
params.description: Companies incorporated in the last N days (default 7).

params.name: sicCodes
params.description: SIC codes, e.g. ['62012'] for software development.

params.name: sicKeywords
params.description: Industry keywords matched against SIC descriptions, e.g. ['restaurant'].

params.name: location
params.description: Town, city or county, e.g. 'Manchester'.

params.name: includeOfficers
params.description: Include directors and officers (default true).

actors.title: TikTok Transcript Scraper
actors.description: Get transcripts of TikTok videos from video URLs or profile handles. Uses TikTok's own captions first and AI speech-to-text only when captions are missing. Returns transcript text, timestamped segments, language, views and likes. Priced per transcript.

params.name: videoUrls
params.description: TikTok video URLs.

params.name: profiles
params.description: TikTok handles (without @) to pull recent videos from.

params.name: maxVideosPerProfile
params.description: Recent videos per profile (default 4).

params.name: aiFallback
params.description: Use AI transcription when captions are missing (default true, billed per minute).

params.name: preferredLanguage
params.description: Preferred caption language code, e.g. 'en'.

actors.title: Luma Event Organizer Leads
actors.description: Scrape Luma (lu.ma) events by city and category and get one lead row per organizer (website, socials, followers, events hosted, average guests, paid-ticket share), or raw event rows in 'events' mode. Priced per organizer or event.

params.name: mode
params.description: One row per organizer (default) or per event.

params.name: cities
params.description: Luma city slugs, e.g. ['sf', 'nyc', 'london'].

params.name: categories
params.description: Luma categories, e.g. ['tech', 'ai', 'crypto'].

params.name: calendars
params.description: Specific Luma calendar URLs or slugs (optional).

params.name: onlyPaidEvents
params.description: Only events with paid tickets.

actors.title: Google Hotels Prices Scraper
actors.description: Get Google Hotels prices from every seller (Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Agoda, the official site and more) for exact dates, by city search or specific hotels. Good for rate shopping and rate-parity checks. Priced per hotel-date.

params.name: queries
params.description: Google Hotels searches, e.g. ['hotels in Austin'].

params.name: checkInDate
params.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD (default: daysAhead from today).

params.name: checkOutDate
params.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: adults
params.description: Number of adults (default 2).

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code (default USD).

params.name: maxHotels
params.description: Hotels per search query (default 3).

actors.title: Google Ads Transparency Scraper
actors.description: Scrape a brand's ads from the Google Ads Transparency Center by domain or advertiser name: first/last shown dates, format, Search ad copy as text (headline, description, sitelinks) and YouTube links. 'domainCheck' mode tells you which domains run Google ads. Priced per ad.

params.name: mode
params.description: Get ads (default) or just check whether domains advertise.

params.name: domains
params.description: Advertiser domains, e.g. ['nike.com'].

params.name: advertiserNames
params.description: Advertiser names to look up.

params.name: region
params.description: Country code (default US) or 'anywhere'.

params.name: maxAdsPerTarget
params.description: Ads per domain or advertiser (default 20).

actors.title: Telegram Channel Scraper
actors.description: Scrape posts from public Telegram channels: text, views, reactions, media and comment counts, plus a stats row with exact subscriber count. No login needed. Priced per post.

params.name: channels
params.description: Channel usernames or t.me links, e.g. ['durov'].

params.name: maxPostsPerChannel
params.description: Recent posts per channel (default 50).

params.name: searchQuery
params.description: Only posts matching this search.

params.name: dateFrom
params.description: Only posts on or after YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: includeChannelStats
params.description: Add a channel stats row (default true).
